headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Exchange Control
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has sharpened across the six hottest sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, logging twenty‑two ownership changes in the past day; Colonial dead have risen to 159,244 and Warden dead to 175,528, with both casualty streams and enlistments now accelerating. Linn Mercy still drives heavy fighting around Lathair, recording sixteen flips, 50,454 Colonial and 62,084 Warden casualties, and a sharp acceleration in Warden losses and recruitment. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to eleven flips, Colonial casualties reaching 41,657 and Warden 49,745, both casualty streams now accelerating while enlistments climb. Mooring County holds at eight flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 2,474 Colonial and 2,253 Warden dead, with all rate trends accelerating. Stlican Shelf records seven flips, casualties climbing to 50,720 Colonial and 56,120 Warden, the latest hour showing cooling casualties but accelerating enlistments. DeadLands has entered the active list with five flips since dawn, adding 3,573 Colonial and 6,924 Warden dead in the last day. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain static, reporting no ownership changes.
